title: Beneath the Lost World
author: Maya Collins
description: Civilizations rise, cities disappear, languages fall silent, and entire chapters of human history become buried beneath forests, deserts, oceans, and modern streets.Beneath the Lost World is a documentary podcast exploring lost cities, ancient civilizations, archaeological discoveries, forgotten cultures, mysterious burials, undeciphered scripts, ancient DNA, vanished trade networks, and the scientific evidence reshaping what we know about the human past.Each episode begins with a discovery: a city revealed beneath a jungle canopy, a skeleton carrying an unexpected genetic history, a tablet written in a language no one can read, or the remains of a settlement swallowed by the sea. Then we follow the evidence.Through archaeology, radiocarbon dating, DNA, isotopes, LiDAR, ancient texts, and excavation, we investigate who these people were, how they lived, why their societies changed, and what truly happened when their cities were abandoned.No ancient aliens. No impossible civilizations. No manufactured mysteries.Just real people, extraordinary discoveries, and the parts of human history still waiting to be understood.

title: Jay Shetty - Biography Flash

description:
Dive into the extraordinary life and evolving story of Jay Shetty, the former monk turned global motivational powerhouse, bestselling author, and host of the chart-topping On Purpose podcast. This show delivers a comprehensive biography of Jay Shetty, tracing his journey from growing up in a Hindu family of Indian origin in North London to his years studying management science at Bayes Business School, his transformative experience with the Hare Krishna movement, and his time living as a Vedic monk in the early 2010s. Explore how Shetty launched his career at Accenture, built a massive social media following with billions of video views, earned a spot on the Forbes 30 Under 30 list, and became one of the most recognized wellness and personal development voices in the world. From his number one New York Times bestselling book Think Like a Monk to his groundbreaking interviews with world leaders including President Joe Biden, from co-founding an adaptogenic tea brand with his wife Radhi Devlukia-Shetty to joining the Calm meditation app and becoming a part-owner of Angel City FC, this podcast covers every milestone, achievement, and venture that has defined Jay Shetty's remarkable career. We also take an honest look at the controversies that have followed him, including questions about uncredited content, inconsistent timelines regarding his monk years, and investigative reports into his Jay Shetty Certification School. Beyond the biography, this show keeps you informed with regular updates on the latest Jay Shetty news, events, projects, and public appearances so you never miss a beat. Whether you are a longtime follower of Jay Shetty's teachings on mindfulness, purpose, and personal growth or you are just discovering his story for the first time, this podcast is your go-to source for everything you need to know about one of the most influential motivational figures of our time. Subscribe now and stay up to date on Jay Shetty's life, career, and continuing impact on millions around the world.
For more content like this, visit QuietPlease.ai

Now Geoff is exploring what that diagnosis means for his past, his relationships, his work, his parenting, and his future.

Along the way, he’ll share his own story, talk with autistic adults and experts, unpack what he’s learning, and explore the questions that come with discovering yourself later in life.

Late to the Spectrum isn’t about having all the answers. It’s about asking better questions, understanding ourselves a little better, and figuring out how to build a life that fits.

If you’re late to the spectrum—or love someone who is—you’re welcome here.

The diagnosis may come late. But the journey starts now.

title: Godless & Moral: Exploring morality without God.
author: Jorge Guerra Pires, Ph.D
description:
Godless & Moral

Explore morality without God.

What remains when we leave religion behind?

Godless & Moral is a secular and openly atheist project dedicated to one of the most difficult questions in philosophy: how can we understand morality without appealing to God, divine revelation, or religious authority?

If there is no divine lawgiver, what grounds the distinction between good and evil, right and wrong? Can moral obligations be objective? Can reason, human flourishing, suffering, cooperation, virtue, or rationality provide a foundation for morality? Or does abandoning religion inevitably lead to moral relativism?

The blog explores these questions through secular ethics, moral philosophy, metaethics, evolutionary perspectives on morality, utilitarianism, virtue ethics, deontology, rationality, and moral realism and anti-realism.

Atheism is not the sole subject of Godless & Moral. It is the starting point: the intellectual premise that allows us to ask what morality might look like once supernatural foundations are removed.

Two particularly important influences on the project are Richard Carrier and Sam Harris. Their work provides very different, sometimes complementary, approaches to secular morality and the relationship between reason, human well-being, and ethics. Their ideas—and the criticisms they have received—will frequently appear throughout the project.

But Godless & Moral is not about defending a single philosopher or presenting a finished secular moral system.

It is about testing ideas.

If morality can exist without God, we should be able to examine its foundations without invoking God. And if secular morality has weaknesses, contradictions, or unanswered questions, those weaknesses deserve to be exposed as well.

No divine commands. No sacred answers. Just the difficult question:

How should we live?

Stay curious.

description: Welcome to Thomas Rocky’s Double Wide—your ultimate non-stop country music party podcast. Whether you are hitting a dirt road in your truck, throwing down for a tailgate party, or chilling on a pontoon boat, this is your weekend soundtrack. We will drop short episodes on the topics that matter most like faith in today's culture, parenting adult children, perimenopause and menopause, singleness, mental health, building wealth and leaving a legacy, real estate and more.

title: St Gregory's Church
author: St Gregory's Church
description:
Welcome to the St Gregory's Podcast! Each week we share talks from our Sunday gatherings in Cornwall, UK. Together we explore the life and teachings of Jesus in a way that is practical, hopeful, and relevant to everyday life.
Whether you're part of our church community, exploring faith for the first time, or simply looking for encouragement, we hope these messages help you encounter God, grow in faith, and follow Jesus in the midst of ordinary life.

title: Goodbye Hitler: A Story for Our Times
author: Hugh Hales-Tooke
description: 'Goodbye Hitler, A Story For Our Times' is a dramatic comedy that I'm reading in 21 episodes. It's set in Germany in 1933, the year Hitler came to power, and centers on Greta Albrecht, a glamorous film executive, her husband Bernard, who is a physicist and expert on rocket propulsion, and their precociously clever thirteen-year-old daughter Hanna, who gets the family into deep trouble.

title: Vinayak Ramesh
author: Vinayak Ramesh
description: Sustainable Side Hustle is an interview show for people building a one person business while still working a day job. The ones stretched thin, doing this mostly alone, scared they're either burning out for nothing or running out of time before they have to choose. Every episode comes back to one moment: when a guest's side income finally became real money, and the decision they made right after it. Some stayed in their job. Some didn't.  You'll walk away knowing what that moment actually looks like, and how to think through the same decision when it's your turn, instead of guessing alone. And I'm not asking these questions from the finish line either. I'm still working my own day job right now, still facing this same decision, using every conversation to work it out alongside you. Life first business, not hustle first. Hosted by Vinayak Ramesh.

title: Sunday at Christ Church Sowerby Bridge
author: Christ Church, Sowerby Bridge
description: Join us each week for the latest sermon from Christ Church Sowerby Bridge, recorded live during our Sunday morning worship. Through Scripture, thoughtful preaching, and practical reflection, we explore how God's Word speaks into our daily lives. Whether you're part of our church family or listening from further afield, we hope these messages encourage your faith, deepen your understanding of the Bible, and inspire you to follow Christ with confidence, hope, and love throughout the week.

title: STRAIGHT... NOT STRAIGHT
author: COIRU NET
description:
Welcome to Straight... Not Straight, an anonymous storytelling podcast show about the moments that did not exactly go according to plan. Real submissions, real human experiences, and absolutely no real names. Because, well, let us be honest, real life rarely stays inside neat little boxes, especially when circumstances get complicated. We are exploring those specific high-friction situations where unspoken boundaries just blur, like a bachelor party that quietly goes way off script, or a canceled flight at midnight that leaves 2 best friends standing in a hotel lobby with only one bed available, looking at each other, thinking, "Wait, what do we do now?" Or a college roommate, a travel adventure, a joke that suddenly stopped feeling like a joke. This is not a podcast about forcing people into labels or handing out neat verdicts. I am not here to analyze whether someone was or secretly this or that all along. We are here to look at what happens when loneliness, alcohol, ego, affection, curiosity, and unexpected attraction all collide in the same room. Some of these accounts will have you laughing at the absolute disaster created by cheap liquor and terrible judgment. Others might catch you off guard with a quiet moment of genuine closeness or sudden vulnerability. Every submission is kept strictly anonymous and retold with complete respect for the people involved. No judgment, no shaming, and 0 cheap sensationalism. Just honest, suspenseful storytelling about the hidden chapters people replay in their heads long after the experience is over. 
New episodes arrive every Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday, presented by Coiru Network. Subscribe now, because sometimes the most unforgettable stories begin right where certainty ends.

title: The Evolutionary Revolutionary (Opti-Mystic Ways that Work)
author: Michael Morrell
description:
The Evolutionary Revolutionary (Opti-Mystic Ways that Work) is where mystics meet misfits and inner transformation collides with radical action—a podcast exploring the living intersection of ancient wisdom and revolutionary imagination.

Host Michael Morrell (co-author of The Divine Dance with Richard Rohr) sits down with muses and musicians, preachers and prophets, theologians and troublemakers who are bridging worlds most people see as separate: the esoteric depths of mystical experience, the mesoteric work of relational and somatic healing, and the exoteric labor of community organizing and social transformation. 

Each conversation asks: What does it look like to wake up—really wake up—in a world aching from our collective alienation from the Sacred, from ourselves, from each other, and from our planet? Through vulnerable storytelling, rigorous inquiry, and practical wisdom, these dialogues offer resources for anyone navigating the edge spaces where spiritual depth meets strategic action, where progressive theology embraces contemplative practice, and where holy fools and sacred revolutionaries are quietly unearthing the world we're longing for. 

Whether you're a contemplative activist, a mystical misfit, or simply seeking sanity in unsettling times, pull up a chair or meditation mat—the most interesting conversations happen in the corners anyway.

title: ART I — AI writes. Artist obeys.
author: Lynette Fisher
description:
What happens when an actual artist hands creative control to artificial intelligence?

ART I is an art podcast with one stupidly simple rule: AI writes every word. Artist Lynette Fisher has to say it.

No edits. No quiet improvements. No deleting the bits she regrets agreeing to.

Together, human and machine stumble through contemporary art, gallery etiquette, artist statements, curators, collectors, artspeak and the peculiar things people do while standing thoughtfully beside a plinth.

Part art podcast, part comedy, part mildly concerning creative experiment, ART I asks what happens when the artist stops being the author and becomes the material.

It may be insightful.

It will definitely be stupid.

AI writes. Artist obeys.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Fantasy Price Check
author: Fantasy Football
description: Fantasy Price Check is the fantasy football debate show where Wyatt Bertolone, Pete Nova, and Coach Retzlaff put player values under the microscope. Every episode, we go round by round comparing players at similar ADPs, breaking down dynasty and redraft values, debating who we’d rather draft, and challenging each other’s rankings. If you’re looking for fantasy football advice, draft strategy, player comparisons, sleepers, busts, and heated debates to help you dominate your league, Fantasy Price Check is the show for you.

title: Houston Moms in the Middle
author: Houston Moms
description:
Parenting teens and tweens doesn't come with an instruction manual … so we made a podcast instead! Houston Moms in the Middle is the show for moms navigating the messy, hilarious, heart-tugging middle years of raising kids from the tween transition all the way through the teenage years.

Every Wednesday {right in the middle of your week, because we're on theme like that}, host Brandi Smith sits down with experts, fellow moms, and the occasional brave teenager to talk about the stuff that keeps us up at night: screen time and social media, teen mental health, communication that doesn't end in a slammed door, keeping kids active, body image, friendships, dating, and everything in between.

Brandi is a former news reporter and a mom right in the thick of it herself, so expect real questions, honest answers, and zero judgment. This is the conversation you'd have with your most-researched mom friend, the one who's already read the studies and talked to the therapist so you don't have to.

Houston Moms in the Middle is part of the Houston Moms family of podcasts. New episodes drop every Wednesday wherever you get your podcasts. Because the middle years are hard … but you don't have to figure them out alone.

title: Journey to Holland
author: Scott Lacey
description:
Journey to Holland started as one dad's honest story of raising a son with Down syndrome. Now it's growing into something bigger: real conversations about what it means to be a Christian father in today's world.

Host Scott Lacey shares candid stories from his own family — the diagnosis, the marriage strain nobody warns you about, the faith questions that came with it, and the everyday grind of raising kids, including one who learns differently. Alongside that, he digs into what Scripture actually says about fatherhood, how to disciple kids in a culture moving faster than ever, and how to lead a family with grace instead of fear.

If you're a dad trying to raise your kids to know God, a parent navigating a Down syndrome or special needs diagnosis, or you just want an honest, faith-centered take on fatherhood that doesn't sugarcoat the hard parts — this show is for you.

New episodes focus on faith, fatherhood, marriage, disability parenting, and raising kids of every kind of ability in a world that's constantly changin

title: An Hourglass Without Time

Welcome to An Hourglass Without Time—a quiet sanctuary for an overthinking mind. 
This space holds raw, acoustic spoken-word poems set against a backdrop of falling rain, soft nighttime ambience or music. Written for dark nights, quiet rooms, and the heavy moments when the silence gets too loud. I hope these words offer an honest place to rest your thoughts across themes of anxiety, depression, grief, love and wonder. 
Put on your headphones, step inside, and leave the rush of the world behind. 
Written and performed by Sapphire Raenz.

author: Brian Lampert
description: The money, missions, and power shaping space. Space Stakes is a daily briefing on the business of the new space race — launches, contracts, constellations, and the capital behind them. Every episode cuts through the industry's hype: signed contracts vs. paper constellations, funded orders vs. "up to" ceilings, launch dates vs. track records. Who pays, who profits, and who actually delivers — told so both aerospace insiders and curious newcomers finish feeling it was made for them. Space Stakes is an AI-voiced podcast, created and built by a real human, Brian Lampert. Nothing on this show is financial advice.

description:
​In modern software engineering, the default state is noise. Between alert fatigue and sprawling infrastructure, it’s easy to get permanently stuck in the operational weeds.
​Out of the Weeds cuts through the chaos. Hosted by Dipesh T., an engineering leader, this podcast delivers pure, actionable signal for tech builders.
​Every episode is a tight, 15-minute playbook on scaling developer productivity, building invisible infrastructure, and pivoting from reactive firefighting to proactive engineering.
​Stop maintaining systems. Start building Golden Paths.

title: The Strange Ordinary

description: AI wasn’t born in Silicon Valley. It has lived in our stories for thousands of years. Joined by a different story guest each week, they travel from ancient automata and Frankenstein to Hollywood robots and the future we thought was coming.

No topic is safe. No story is off-limits. And no tea is too cold to reheat.
THE TEA WILL SPILL - We GuaranTEA
**Put the kettle on, pull up a chair, and take a sip of your new favourite podcast.**

title: AI Powered Founder
author: John McDonald
description:
AI Powered Founder is a real-time look at what it actually takes to get more done as a builder using AI — no hype, no highlight reel.
Host John, a product manager turned founder, is building his own company (Living Stones) as the test case — using AI not as a novelty but as daily working tools. Each episode is honest about what's actually moving the needle versus what's just noise: what worked this week, what didn't, what he changed his mind about.
If you're trying to figure out how to make the most of AI as a builder, and are tired of the AI-Influencer-Hype, this is that show.

title: The Talent Equation L&D Podcast
author: Nolan Hout
description: Explore insights and conversations on modern L&D, talent development, leadership, workplace learning, and the future of work with The Talent Equation L&D Podcast.

title: Amidst the Ordinary
author: Scatter
description:
In this season of Amidst the Ordinary, we talk about community and connection. This innately human urge to be a part of something – to feel seen, heard, and valued by those around us. With stories from small towns in Georgia to the heart of the UAE and countless places in between. We’re here to tell stories, real stories, from real people. 


We’ll reflect on these stories together, discuss how they inspired us, and discover practical ways to apply them to our lives. Whether you move to a new city, country, or simply want to take deeper root where you are, this podcast is for you.

title: The South Dakota Game, Fish and Parks Podcast and Blast

title: Evolving Beyond

description:
Evolving Beyond is a collection of reflections on growth, identity, relationships, self-mastery, and the vulnerable process of becoming.
Here, we explore the ideas, experiences, and questions that help us understand ourselves more deeply and live more intentionally. Not from a place of having all the answers, but from a willingness to stay curious, challenge old narratives, and continue evolving.
If you’re interested in self-awareness, meaningful conversations, and building a life that feels aligned from the inside out, you’re in the right place.

title: Mr. Deep History
author: Mr. Deep History
description:
Mr. Deep History is a calm platform for science-based storytelling from origins to empires. Longform essays on human evolution, archaeology, early civilizations, and how societies change, survive, and collapse - no hype, just the record, told slowly. Designed to help you slow down, focus, and drift off if you want to: perfect for deep work, long walks, late-night thinking, and sleep.

 Episodes are built with respect for evidence, drawing on archaeology, primary texts when available, and modern research. We use AI tools to assist parts of the workflow (research support, drafting, narration, imagery), then edit and polish for clarity and accuracy.

 These videos blend research with documentary-style storytelling for learning and atmosphere - not a substitute for academic or professional advice. Reconstructions are interpretive, and all visuals are AI-generated artistic impressions.

Sit back. Listen. Relax. Think. Thanks for being here 😊

title: Triumph Church

description:
The vision of Triumph Church is to cultivate a legacy of faith for future generations.

At Triumph Church, we are a Spirit-led, presence-driven community planted in the heart of Blacktown. We are not built around personalities, programs, or traditions we are built on Christ and the power of His presence. title: Anyway, Back To The Point
author: Lara Greenway and Emma Peel
description:
Anyway, Back to the Point is a funny, honest midlife podcast about masking, coping, people-pleasing, burnout and the things we thought were “just us”. 
Hosted by Lara and Emma, it’s a space for lived experience, big lightbulb moments and the kind of conversations women often have in private. We talk midlife, identity, possible neurodivergence, menopause, anxiety, friendship, work, family, unmasking and the relief of finally joining the dots. 
Expect humour, honesty, tangents, swearing and the occasional “anyway, back to the point…”

title: Beyond the Bar Podcast
author: Jake Grindeland
description:
Beyond the Bar goes behind the businesses and beyond the polished success stories to uncover the real stories of the people who risked it all to build something of their own.
Hosted by the owner of Cornerstone Pub and Prime, Beyond the Bar features honest, entertaining conversations with entrepreneurs, restaurant owners, community leaders, and other driven people about what it actually takes to build a business, overcome setbacks, lead people, and keep going when things don't go according to plan.
From hospitality and small-town entrepreneurship to leadership, community, culture, failure, growth, and the lessons learned along the way, these aren't scripted success stories. They're real conversations about the wins, mistakes, sacrifices, and crazy moments that happen behind the scenes.
Born inside Cornerstone Pub and Prime, Beyond the Bar is about more than restaurants. It's about the people behind the businesses that serve our communities.
Real people. Real businesses. Real stories beyond the bar.

description: This podcast highlights the ongoing salience of the academic Study of Religion for understanding our every day world. Each episode examines one text of ‘smut’ to explore a major concept or theory in religious studies. This series is aimed for an educated public, with the intention of acting as a companion to undergraduate courses examining the intersection of religion, sex, sexuality, gender, bodies, and the erotic.

title: Between Teacher and Self
author: Dr. Cathy White
description:
Between Teacher and Self explores the relationship between who we are as people, who we become as teachers, and the experiences and systems that shape both.


Over time, teaching can become intertwined with identity. We become the reliable teacher, the fixer, the one who can handle anything, the person everyone comes to, the teacher who always cares a little more or takes on a little more. Those identities can bring competence, purpose, connection, and success, but they can also shape what we believe we're allowed to need, refuse, question, or change.


Hosted by educator and author Dr. Cathy White, Between Teacher and Self looks beneath familiar experiences in teaching to ask different questions: Why can setting a reasonable boundary feel like being a bad teacher? What happens when competence becomes part of your sense of self? Why can the same person thrive in one school and struggle in another? And how do you know which parts of your teaching identity are truly yours?


This isn't a podcast about becoming a better, more productive, or more resilient teacher. It's a podcast about understanding the person inside the role, because the work shapes who we become and who we become shapes how we do the work.

title: Thinkin’ Out Loud Podcast

From politics, law, and global events to mental health, generational trauma, faith, culture, and personal growth, each episode explores the ideas shaping our world and our lives. Through honest dialogue and thoughtful analysis, we challenge assumptions, unpack complex issues, and find meaning in everyday experiences. Whether you're seeking perspective, inspiration, or a deeper understanding of the world around you, this is a space to think critically, grow intentionally, and never stop asking questions.

Welcome to The Community Podcast, your source for local stories, conversations and community events happening in your local community! From the people and businesses shaping our communities to local events, hidden gems, new developments, and the stories worth knowing, we're here to keep you connected to the communities around you!
Each week, we take you across Central Iowa through Western Edge, Urban Loop, and Upper East Side, bringing you local voices, community leaders, businesses, and neighbors who make each area unique. 
Whether we're talking about what to do this weekend, sharing a longtime local tradition, introducing you to someone making an impact, or exploring what's next for our communities, there's always something new to discover!

Whether you're growing in your faith or serving God's church, my prayer is that every episode equips you to know Christ more deeply, faithfully serve His church, and live for His glory.

Host Daniel Druger sits down with entrepreneurs who had more conviction than credentials, more vision than validation, and a very healthy dose of delusion to go all in and build something real. This isn't 'How I Built This', this is 'How I'm Building This', made for the next generation of founders. Every episode is proof that you don't need experience, connections, or permission to start.

title: The Christine Beard Leadership Collection
author: Christine Beard
description:
Practical leadership for people responsible for people, performance and results.

Leadership isn't complicated because we don't know enough theories. It's complicated because it involves people.

The Christine Beard Leadership Collection explores the everyday work of leading and managing well — building capable people, creating accountability, having the conversations you'd rather avoid, developing managers who can think for themselves, and building businesses that don't depend on one person holding everything together.

Christine Beard is a business coach who has spent years working alongside business owners and leaders dealing with the real problems that come with managing people and growing businesses.

No management theatre. No leadership heroics. Just practical ideas, questions and tools to help you become a better leader — and build stronger leaders underneath you.

title: The Grimdark Historian: A Warhammer 40K Lorecast
author: Dr Jason Edwards
description:
In the Grim Darkness of the Far Future there is only History. Explore the vast, violent, and endlessly fascinating universe of Warhammer 40,000 (W40K) through an educational audio-documentary series dedicated to the history, factions, characters, wars, worlds, technology, and mysteries of the 41st Millennium. Each season takes a focused journey into Warhammer 40K lore, examining subjects ranging from the Imperium of Man, Space Marines, Primarchs, and the Horus Heresy to Chaos, the Aeldari, Necrons, Orks, Tyranids, T’au Empire, and the countless conflicts that have shaped the galaxy. Episodes combine historical context, military analysis, political intrigue, religion, technology, and mythology to explain not only what happened, but why these events and ideas matter within the larger Warhammer 40,000 setting.

Designed for longtime fans and newcomers alike, the podcast approaches 40K as a living fictional history filled with competing accounts, ancient legends, unreliable narrators, lost civilizations, and unanswered questions. Discover the origins of legendary warriors, follow galaxy-changing campaigns, examine forbidden technologies, explore the Warp and Webway, and investigate mysteries that even the Imperium cannot fully explain. Rather than reducing the setting to simple summaries or power rankings, each episode seeks to provide accessible, thoughtful context while preserving the scale, tragedy, uncertainty, and atmosphere that make Warhammer 40,000 unique. Visit ImaginedBattlefield.com for more military history and science fiction.

title: Go Slow. Study Deep. Be Transformed.
author: Rebecca — Lyric and Letter Studios
description: Go Slow. Study Deep. Be Transformed. is a Bible study podcast for women who want to move beyond surface-level reading and study Scripture deeply and faithfully. Journey chronologically from Genesis to Revelation as we observe the text, explore its context, trace biblical themes, and see how the whole story points to Christ. Study alongside the Lyric & Letter Companion Study App, where each passage is explored using our complete Study Method. Open your Bible, bring your questions, and let’s study together.

title: Miles Together✨️
author: Rachel Norton
description:
Welcome to Miles Together!✨️
a podcast about becoming your best self while exploring the world!🌍
Through honest conversations, personal stories, and lessons learned along the way, we'll talk about growth, fear, confidence, travel, and what it really means to build a life that feels like your own.
If you've ever felt like you're behind in life, stuck in a routine, or searching for something more, this is your reminder that you're not alone.
Let's take the journey together & become our best selves together!

author: Leo Mind and Body
description: Chronic, Not Crazy is a podcast hosted by Ava and Maddie, in collaboration with Leo Mind and Body. We talk openly about endometriosis, adenomyosis, and the realities of living with chronic illness—from symptoms and diagnosis to treatment, medical gaslighting, relationships, and everything in between. Through honest conversations, personal stories, and guests who have lived it, we’re creating a space where you feel heard, understood, and less alone. Your symptoms are real. Your story matters. You’re Chronic, Not Crazy.

description:
Real women. Real talk. Real life is messy as hell.


We’re everyday women having honest conversations about the uncomfortable, complicated, heartbreaking, and downright messy parts of life—the things we sometimes hide in our effort to look like we have it all figured out.


We’re not experts, and we’re not here to give you advice or tell you how to fix your life. We’re just here to talk about it—the good, the bad, and the gloriously messy—and remind each other that maybe we don’t have to have it all figured out.

description:
If you love someone who struggles with depression, you know it can affect more than the person experiencing it. It can change your marriage, family, and sometimes even your sense of who you are.
 Here I'll talk honestly about what it’s like to navigate depression in a marriage—the hard parts, the things I’ve learned along the way, and the practical tools that can help.
Together, we’ll explore how to support the person you love, rebuild connection, and find hope in the middle of a really hard season.
Because you don’t have to choose between loving your spouse and taking care of yourself.

From targeting grouper and snapper to offshore fishing adventures across Southwest Florida and the Gulf, Captain Gordie shares fishing tips, wild charter stories, big catches, rough seas, and plenty of laughs along the way. If you love saltwater fishing, offshore fishing, and the lifestyle that comes with it, welcome to Lucky Strike Livin’.

description:
Welcome to An Officer and A Gentleman Podcast, the show where two best friends sit down to talk about what it really means to be a man in today’s world. We don't have all the answers; we're just two guys working to build better lives and futures by focusing on character, discipline, faith, and the lessons we've learned the hard way. Each week we tackle issues like the evolution of masculinity, what does chivalry mean today, relationships (platonic and otherwise), brotherhood, and things men go through, but don't often discuss.

In each episode, the team at Catamaran Central discusses the latest topics shaping the multihull world, answers frequently asked questions, shares insights into the catamaran brokerage market, and takes a closer look at a featured make and model.
The conversations are unscripted, unfiltered, and driven by a genuine love of life between the hulls. 
It's simply a couple of catamaran enthusiasts talking about what they know and love best: catamarans.

title: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu Official Podcast
author: Lucasfilms, Jon Favreau
description: A two episode series designed to take Star Wars' biggest and newest fans behind the scenes of Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu, in conjunction with the film's release on Disney+. Shot on the movie's Adelphi Base Bar set, guests include writer-director Jon Favreau, the President of Lucasfilm, Dave Filoni, Academy-Award winning composer Ludwig Göransson and the on-screen stars of the film, Pedro Pascal and Sigourney Weaver. Even Grogu himself swings by, to inject a heavy dose of cuteness into the series as the creative team discusses the ingredients that made this film so special, as both a fresh chapter in Star Wars' remarkable history, and an exciting new page in the Mandalorian and Grogu's own stories.

Less fixing.

More clarity.

title: New Business Jump Start Show
author: Evan Palmer
description:
• New Business Jump Start Show

  • If you've ever thought about starting your own business, this is the podcast for you. Perhaps you've had a career doing something else and are ready to finally jump into the entrepreneurial waters. Maybe you're looking to build a profitable side project. Or perhaps there's an idea you've had for a long time and you're ready to finally take action. Whatever the situation may be, when people go into business for themselves, there's a LOT to know: accounting, sales, marketing, production, customer service, billing, finance, legal, human resources, etc. In addition to not knowing enough about each aspect, the larger reality is that you don't know what you don't know, and often don't know whom to ask for help. Our podcast guests offer insights into each area of business, helping you to gain knowledge and focus on the most important elements. We'll discuss everything from overcoming common obstacles to selling and promoting yourself and your business or service, and lots more. We want to give you an advantage because we've been there and done that and we want you to learn from our mistakes as well as our successes.

title: Under The Steeple

description: Under the Steeple is a church operations podcast about the people, decisions, systems, and surprises that keep ministry moving. It is an honest and occasionally humorous look at what happens behind the scenes, between Sundays, and whenever ministry meets reality.

title: The We Ain't Perfect Podcast
author: Bruno & Z
description:
We Ain’t Perfect is where real life meets real conversation. Hosted by husband-and-wife duo Bruno and Z, we’re talking marriage, relationships, adulting, culture, current events, and all the wild stuff life throws at us—with plenty of laughs, honest opinions, disagreements, and unfiltered banter along the way. We don’t have all the answers, we won’t always agree, and we definitely don’t get everything right.

But that’s the point… We Ain’t Perfect.

title: Unrig America with Sasha Abramsky
author: SEIU California
description:
Welcome to the Unrig America podcast. Host, author, and journalist Sasha Abramsky will be talking with policy experts, advocates, and workers about what rising inequality in today's United States looks like and means on the ground -- and about what can be done to reverse course. 

©2026 Unrig America Podcast is a production of SEIU California.

title: Worry About Yourself
author: Lauren Mooney Jones
description:
This podcast was born from the ways God has transformed me and taught me how to stop allowing my circumstances to control my emotions, my choices, and my life. 
We’re going to talk all about how get our lives back by stewarding what we have instead of worrying about what we can’t control. Through scripture, science, and a little bit of tough love, we’re going to help each other grow in our faith, in our relationships, and into the best versions of ourselves - becoming exactly who God created you to be. But in order to do that, you’ve got to do what your momma said and worry about yourself 💅

title: Cafe Crossing Worlds

description:
What happens when you cross worlds?
A girl from India who crossed over to the UK, found comfort in cafés, unfamiliar faces and new experiences — and discovered herself along the way.
For anyone crossing worlds, physically, mentally or emotionally, come sit with me.
Wherever you go, you are your own world. ☕️🌍

title: Stealing the Moment
author: Katie and Sean
description:
Stealing the Moment is a passionate, baseball-loving conversation between Katie Redmiles and her brother Sean as they explore the launch of the Women’s Professional Baseball League and what it means for the future of the sport. Equal parts sports talk, history, and personal reflection, the show follows their deep love of baseball, their excitement about seeing women finally have a true professional path in the game, and their candid reactions to the league’s inaugural season and the emotional weight of this historic moment.

Be a part of a new sports era and steal this moment!

title: The Drift Den Podcast
author: thedriftdenpod
description:
I wanted to create The Drift Den as a soft-landing place, a space where you can gently unwind, settle your thoughts, and ease your body into rest through guided meditations and bedtime stories.

Living with chronic illness and chronic pain has made sleep a challenge for me, but over the last six years, meditation and soothing nighttime stories have become a lifeline, helping me drift into sleep with more comfort and calm.

I wanted to build a sanctuary for anyone who struggles to fall asleep, wrestles with racing thoughts, or simply needs a moment to exhale. Whether you’re here to relax, to reset, or to drift off completely, this space is for you.

From career and money to relationships, health and bold reinvention, expect remarkable stories, smart advice and big ideas — all with one thing in mind: creating a life you actually want, at any age.

title: I Wish Somebody Told Me
author: Jason Malone
description:
Nobody sat us down and explained how to protect what we build. No one in our family talked about trusts, wills, probate, or what happens to everything we worked for when we are gone. Most of us figured it out too late. Our families paid the price because we never figured it out at all. I Wish Somebody Told Me is the show that fills that gap. Visit fortitudefinancial.co to build your personalized estate plan and take the first step toward protecting everything you have built.

Every episode breaks down estate planning, asset protection, and wealth transfer in plain language. No jargon. No gatekeeping. No assumptions that you already know how this works. Because most of us were never taught. If you own a home, run a business, have children, or have anything worth protecting this show is for you. Topics we cover: how to avoid probate, the difference between a will and a trust, how to fund a trust properly, protecting your business for the next generation, estate planning for blended families, how to transfer wealth without court involvement, and the mistakes that cost families everything they built.

Hosted by Jason Malone, founder of Fortitude Financial. Licensed estate planning advisor with a background in institutional finance and Wall Street. Jason built this practice specifically to give our community access to the same level of planning that wealthy families have used for generations. New episodes every two weeks. Subscribe so you never miss one. This podcast is for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal or tax advice. Estate planning services provided by Fortitude Financial.

title: Nurture With Nature Podcast
author: MCXI Studios
description:
Nurture With Nature Podcast
What happens when we slow down, step outside, and have a real conversation?
The Nurture With Nature Podcast is the audio arm of the larger Nurture With Nature project, exploring how spending time in nature can shape the way we think, connect, create, heal, and move through everyday life.
Hosted by photographer and creator Humble Lyons, each episode takes the conversation outdoors. No cameras. No lights. No studio distractions. Just two people walking, talking, listening, and allowing nature to become part of the experience.
Guests come from different walks of life, including educators, naturalists, artists, health professionals, community leaders, researchers, and everyday people with meaningful relationships to the outdoors. Conversations explore their personal stories, their work, what nature has taught them, and the different ways they have learned to interact with the world around them.
Each episode also includes a moment of intentional silence, giving both the guest and listener a chance to stop talking, listen, reflect, and simply experience the environment.
And nature does not have to mean hiking a mountain or disappearing into the wilderness. It can be walking through a park, sitting beside the water, spending time on your patio, watching the stars, tending to a plant, or simply stepping outside for a little fresh air.
The goal is simple: have great conversations in nature, about nature, while discovering practical and sometimes unexpected ways nature can become part of our everyday lives.
This podcast shares personal experiences, ideas, and perspectives and is not intended to provide medical advice.
Put on your headphones and come take a walk with us.

title: Quantum Empathy Alliance Podcast
author: Cliff Eggert
description:
If you’ve ever felt broken, lost, numb, or like no one truly understands what you’re carrying, you’re not alone. Quantum Empathy Alliance isn’t about pretending life is easy or offering empty motivational speeches. It’s about honest conversations, understanding how pain changes us, rebuilding trust without the guilt or shame and finding a path forward one step at a time. 

We’re not therapists, and we don’t pretend to have all the answers. We simply share our own experiences with trauma, loss, pain, and healing in the hope that something we learned might help you discover something within yourself. Maybe, just maybe, you might recognize something that could be a catalyst for understanding and change within yourself or perhaps you'll recognize someone in your life who needs to hear this conversation.

Whether you’re struggling with trauma, grief, anxiety, depression, or simply trying to rediscover who you are, this is a place where honesty comes first and hope is allowed to exist. We’re not here to tell you who you are or who to become. We’re here to help you remember who you are.

title: Murder Rounds: True Crime from Inside Medicine
author: NURSING.com
description:
very hospital runs on trust. These are the cases where that trust was the weapon.
Murder Rounds is a true crime podcast about healthcare's most disturbing killers — the nurses and doctors who murdered the patients they were meant to protect — told by the people who actually work in those buildings.
Each episode goes past the headlines to the part nobody covers: how they got away with it for so long. The neutral reference. The report filed into a channel designed to keep it invisible. The records destroyed under subpoena. In case after case, the institution's first instinct was to protect itself.
Every episode ends with The Chart Review — a segment where we set the story aside and ask what actually changed. What safeguards exist now. What a clinician should do today if they see something. What the system learned, and what it didn't.
Researched, written, and reviewed by real nurses. Every claim sourced to court records, inquiry reports, and contemporaneous journalism — not true-crime folklore. Where the evidence is disputed, we say so.

In this podcast series, Cedric Speyer and DeeAnna Nagel engage in conversations with psychospiritual trailblazers, amplifying their voices of wisdom and exploring their unique perspectives on human wholeness. While their names might not grace network news or mainstream podcasts, their insights introduce invaluable aspects of ‘soul work’.  Soul work (and play) transcends the mere amalgamation of mental and emotional well-being, optimum personality traits, and worldly life skills. It delves deeper, calling forth spiritual capacities at the growing edge of our life's purpose. It allows individual talents and personal pathways to converge with what the world needs. description:
Change is already working on you. Could you make it work for you?


Chief Change Officer™ is a podcast for people who want to turn change into a breakthrough. It is for those reshaping a career, redirecting an organization, or rebuilding a life.


The show is hosted by Vince Chan, whose first lesson in change came at age four, after a severe arm injury led to surgery, hospitalization, and a long recovery. Since adolescence, she has lived through 20 major transformations across countries, careers, and crises. Before launching the podcast, she spent three decades in global finance and economics, from central banking and credit markets to billion-dollar institutional capital.


That experience taught her that change is never only personal. Markets shift. Institutions decide. Circumstances expand or narrow what people believe is possible. Talent matters, but so do context, timing, and power.


Vince brings together rare minds, black sheep, breakthrough builders, and unconventional champions from around the world. They include scholars who have spent decades studying people and institutions, executives who have carried responsibility through uncertainty, and leaders whose most valuable knowledge was earned beyond the clean lines of a textbook.


Together, they bring what Vince calls hard-earned human intelligence: judgment shaped by consequence and tested by time, trial, and revision.


They do not offer polished success stories or textbook formulas. They reveal what helped when plans collapsed, careers broke open, or life demanded a new direction.


Each conversation turns hard-earned human intelligence into practical judgment: how to understand what is changing, make stronger decisions, and move forward without losing yourself.


Chief Change Officer™ extends Vince’s work beyond markets and institutions into the human side of power and change. How people understand themselves, navigate their environment, and reclaim agency when the old rules no longer hold.


A Global Top 1% podcast and US #1 Careers show, Chief Change Officer™ is built for people who do not want merely to endure change. They want to understand it, use it, and turn it into a breakthrough.


Life is change. The question is whether change works on you, or you learn to make it work for you.

Pastoral Problems is where pastors Phil Stanley and Justin Wright talk honestly about ministry—the meaningful, the messy, and the completely ridiculous. Every episode pulls the listener inside a world most people only read headlines about - the rise, the obsession, the fall, and the uncomfortable truth underneath it all.

title: VOICES OF GREYSTONES
author: High Tide Studios
description:
Every town has its stories. Some are well known. Most are quietly carried by the people who live there.


Voices of Greystones is a community podcast celebrating the people, memories and moments that make one of Ireland's most remarkable coastal towns unique.


From lifelong locals and newcomers to business owners, artists, volunteers and everyday people with extraordinary experiences, every conversation is a chance to capture a piece of Greystones that might otherwise be lost to time.


Some stories will make you laugh. Others may move you or inspire you. Together, they create a lasting record of the people who make this community what it is.

Recorded at High Tide Studios in the heart of Greystones, every episode begins with a simple coffee and a chat before becoming an honest conversation, preserved for future generations.


Everyone in this town has a story. Some just haven't been asked yet.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: A Simple and Purposeful Home
author: Devon Norris
description:
Purpose needs breathing room.
Home is so much bigger, richer, and simpler than we have been told.
A Simple and Purposeful Home is for the mom who is searching for meaning but exhausted by the world's complicated, anxious solutions — the one who scrolls Instagram and Pinterest and TikTok, overwhelmed and defeated.
I'm Devon — pediatric cardiac nurse turned homeschool mom, grain miller, healthy home consultant, & small business owner. Not here to tell you what to do or make you feel behind. Just honest conversation about what I'm trying, and freedom to take what works for your family.

title: Let's Talk Email
author: Steven Sayo & Jay Oram
description: Welcome to Let's Talk Email, the podcast that dives deep into the world of email. Join hosts Jay Oram and Steven Sayo as they explore everything from the intricacies of email design and coding to the latest platforms, accessibility best practices, and upcoming industry events. Whether you're a seasoned email developer, a marketer looking to boost your campaigns, or simply curious about the technology behind your inbox, Let's Talk Email is your essential guide to navigating the ever-evolving landscape of digital communication. Tune in for expert insights, lively discussions, and a healthy dose of email geekery.

title: The sanderstamorie6’s Podcast
author: sanderstamorie6
description:
CNA Real Talk is the podcast for Certified Nursing Assistants who want to grow their skills, confidence, and professionalism. Hosted by an experienced CNA, each episode teaches one practical lesson you can use on your very next shift. Through real stories, real workplace situations, and actionable advice, you’ll learn better communication, teamwork, resident care, professionalism, safety, and career success. Whether you’re a new CNA or a seasoned caregiver, this podcast will help you provide exceptional care and become the kind of CNA residents, families, and employers remember.
Real Stories. Real Advice. Real Impact.

author: Tracy Fance
description:
Have you ever asked yourself why this keeps happening?
The same relationship. The symptom nobody can explain. The pattern you can't break. The feeling life is stuck on repeat.
The Healer Within is for the woman who's done the therapy, read the books, tried everything, and still can't get to the root of it.
I'm Tracy Fance. For over sixteen years I've helped women find the real root of what's driving their health, their relationships and their repeating patterns.
One idea. One story. 15-20 minutes. Raw and honest.
The healer is already within you. This podcast helps you find her.

title: Kiltman’s Kitchen
author: Keith “Kiltman” Robinson
description:
Now let’s get this clear right from the start - I’m not a professional cook by any stretch of the imagination, nor do I have any formal culinary qualifications.

author: Mara Kaufman
description: Practical Insights is for people if who are sick of dating and want a serious committed “in-love” relationship. You’ll gain the tools to understand yourself and your relationships more deeply, so you can create the relationship you actually want. Each episode explores the complicated human stuff underneath relationships and turns it into practical insights you can use. Mara’s practical, actionable perspective helps you understand your patterns, your needs, and what you bring to a relationship. You’ll learn how to move toward a long-lasting, committed relationship where you can be fully yourself, have amazing chemistry, want the same kind of life together, get through the rough patches and enjoy each other. Mara took about 5-7 different programs to improve her relationships when she was single, had years of therapy, had multiple serious-committed relationships where they were in love , ending with her husband. title: The Faith We Share Podcast
author: The Faith We Share Podcast
description: The Faith We Share is a mother-and-daughter journey through God’s Word, reading the Bible together one chapter at a time and sharing honest thoughts, questions and discoveries along the way. Following a chronological reading plan, we explore scripture in a warm, family-friendly way, learning together what God’s Word has to teach us. Whether you’re a parent listening with your child or simply looking for a gentle way for them to explore the Bible, we hope you’ll feel encouraged, inspired and reminded that faith is something beautiful to share.

title: Everything’s Fine (But It’s Not)
author: Ebony In-depth
description: Everything’s Fine (But It’s Not) is a raw, funny, and emotionally honest podcast about the invisible weight people carry while trying to hold life together. Through real conversations about motherhood, relationships, family struggles, healing, emotional burnout, identity, and everyday survival, therapist and mom Ebony gives language to experiences many silently live through. Whether it looks like over-functioning, shutting down, avoiding, overthinking, or overplanning what’s next, this podcast is for the people everyone depends on — often while struggling more than anyone realizes.

title: A Pocket Full of Jewels
author: Julie Marie
description:
Life isn’t always sparkly. Sometimes it’s messy, heavy, confusing, and downright hard—but even in the hardest moments, there are little pieces of beauty worth finding.
Welcome to *A Pocket Full of Jewels* , a podcast hosted by Julie where we talk about real life, real feelings, personal growth, relationships, motherhood, starting over, finding yourself, and those moments when you need a little reminder that you’re stronger than you think.
This isn’t a podcast about having everything figured out. It’s about being honest about the journey—the good days, the bad days, the lessons, the laughter, and the moments that shape who we become.
Think of each episode as a little jewel to put in your pocket and carry with you: a thought, a story, a laugh, or a reminder that might be exactly what you needed to hear that day.
Because sometimes, when life feels heavy, *you just have to find your sparkle again.* ✨💎
Come sit with me, grab your coffee, and let’s find the jewels hidden in everyday life.
*A Pocket Full of Jewels — because there’s always a little sparkle somewhere.*

Life doesn't come with a map. 
But every person we meet leaves behind clues, lessons, and experiences that can help us navigate our own path.
In my podcast, I sit down with leaders, creators, entrepreneurs, and innovators to uncover what they've learned along the way: the successes, the failures, and the decisions that shaped their journey.
Because the goal isn't to follow someone else's map exactly. It's to learn from it, create our own path, and leave a clearer map behind for others.
I'm Larisa, and this is be-teachable.

title: Excellence Becoming
author: K. Joia Houheneka
description: You can build a successful business and still feel that your most important work is ahead of you.  Excellence Becoming is a podcast for entrepreneurs and creators who have already built good lives, but want greater excellence and fresh perspective for what they’re becoming.  Hosted by entrepreneur, coach, publisher, and researcher of human flourishing K. Joia Houheneka, the show explores how excellence is actually formed over a lifetime.  Through conversations with entrepreneurs, creators, and other exemplars, Excellence Becoming goes beneath polished success stories to uncover the formative experiences that shape a life: failures that changed everything, tensions that demanded growth, mistakes that became turning points, and moments of reinvention that transformed success into something deeper.  Because excellence is not a destination.  It is a process of becoming.  Produced by The Worthy Excellence Institute and Gold Standards Media, this podcast is part of a larger exploration of human excellence, self-actualization, entrepreneurship, philosophy, and the conditions that allow human beings to flourish.  If you are building a business in alignment with a worthwhile life, if you believe entrepreneurship can be an expression of who you are rather than simply a way to earn a living, and if you are seeking greater integration between mission, prosperity, contribution, beauty, and legacy, you will feel at home here.  As our gift to listeners, we invite you to receive a complimentary issue of Gold Standards Magazine, where we celebrate the entrepreneurs, creators, and institutions whose work embodies excellence. At Freedonomix, we dive into two key areas, Practical Financial Wisdom (tax, investing, wealth strategies etc.) as well as Inspiring Life Stories from friends and clients . 
Whether you're here for the financial insights, the personal stories, or a bit of both, we're glad you've joined us.
Lets get started.

title: Mersey Views
author: Liverpool City Council
description:
Mersey Views is Liverpool City Council's monthly podcast: an honest, plainspoken conversation between the city and the people who run it.

Each episode, council leader Liam Robinson and Dylan Evans take one subject that matters to Liverpool and really get into it, alongside the people living and leading the work. Expect a straight-talking briefing from the leader, a deep dive with guests who know their subject inside out, and Your City, Your Questions, where residents put their questions directly to the leader with no script and no dodging.

This isn't a council broadcast. It's warm, accountable, and confident enough to name what isn't working. From becoming an anti-racist city to backing the next generation, Mersey Views is where Liverpool's real conversations happen.

title: Business Behind the Story
author: Lucas
description:
Business Behind the Story is a documentary podcast about how companies really work — the decisions, strategies, money, competition, and people behind the businesses we know.
Each episode investigates a real company, founder, industry, product, rivalry, collapse, or turnaround. We look beyond headlines and corporate mythology to understand how the business actually made money, what gave it an advantage, which decisions changed its trajectory, and what happened when reality stopped matching the plan.
From technology giants and global brands to startups, retailers, airlines, manufacturers, and spectacular corporate failures, Business Behind the Story explores the forces that build companies — and sometimes destroy them.
Because behind every business is a story about ambition, incentives, timing, capital, competition, and human decisions.

title: Walk That Walk - A Christian Podcast

Walk That Walk is a Christian podcast focused on taking faith beyond words and putting it into action. Through honest discussions, scripture-grounded encouragement, and real-life perspectives, we explore what it truly means to follow Jesus in today’s world.
Hit Follow to join the community and step into a stronger, purpose-filled walk with Christ every week.

Whether you're just starting out or have years of experience, Lens Republic is a place to learn, be inspired, and connect with the photography community.

Through honest conversations about relationships, family, personal growth, healing, identity, and everything in between, we explore what it means to keep becoming. Without pretending to have all the answers. We believe you don't have to be in the same chapter to walk alongside someone. Wherever life has taken you, whatever chapter you find yourself in, we're so glad you're here. Let's turn the page together.

description:
BSCP's Trailblazers is a podcast series created by and for the Biomedical Science Careers Program Alumni Network to grow, learn from, and connect with each other as we drive meaningful change in our fields. Through candid conversations with alumni, participants, and partners across all ages and stages of their careers, this series aims to showcase diverse career paths, share lessons learned and leadership insight, and highlight the power of community and long-term professional relationships.
This series is a production of BSCP in Boston, Massachusetts.  Founded in 1991 at Harvard Medical School by Dr. Joan Reede, BSCP began on a local scale and attracted students from Massachusetts and across New England. Today, our reach is national, with representation from all 50 states, Washington, DC, Puerto Rico, and beyond.  For more information go to bscp.org.
Trailblazers is hosted by Jordie Kamuene, PhD, and produced by Jill Ruby.   
The series launches Sept. 1, 2026.  Subscribe to our show wherever you listen to your podcasts.

title: Beyond Plastic: where science meets consciousness
author: Dr. Elie Haddad
description:
"Beyond Plastic: where science meets consciousness" is a journey into the science of living well and the wisdom of living deeply.

Hosted by cardiologist, author, and TEDx speaker Dr. Elie Haddad, the podcast explores the intersection of modern medicine, environmental health, longevity, consciousness, and the deeper questions that shape the way we live.

Drawing from decades in medicine and a lifelong curiosity about the human experience, Dr. Elie moves beyond symptoms and diagnoses to explore the connections between our bodies, our environment, our minds, and our inner lives. Through science, storytelling, and reflection, each series invites us to question what we take for granted, understand the forces shaping our health, and make more conscious choices for ourselves and the world around us.

The journey begins with The Plastic Age, a series tracing the extraordinary rise of plastic from a revolutionary invention to one of the defining materials of our civilization. We’ll explore how it reshaped the way we live, how micro- and nanoplastics found their way into our environment and our bodies, what emerging science is revealing about their impact on human health, and what we can realistically do about it.

Future series will venture into longevity, wellness, consciousness, resilience, purpose, and the evolving science and wisdom of what it means to live a healthier, more meaningful life.

Because living well is about more than adding years to our lives. It is about bringing more life into our years.

title: We Don't Talk About That Podcast
author: Linda Coogan Byrne
description:
We Don't Talk About That is a bold new podcast exploring the conversations society often avoids but desperately needs to have.


Hosted by award-winning campaigner, researcher and author Linda Coogan Byrne alongside Season One special guest co-hosts Ndidi O and Sangeeta Kalsi, the podcast brings together survivors, activists, academics, artists, industry leaders and changemakers for honest, unfiltered discussions about power, inequality, culture, trauma, resilience and social change.


From violence against women and girls, gender inequality and workplace culture to music, media, politics, identity and the stories that shape our lives, no subject is off limits.


Each episode creates space for the voices too often left out of mainstream conversations, combining lived experience, expert insight and challenging dialogue with compassion, humour and curiosity.


At a time when so many important issues are reduced to headlines and soundbites, We Don't Talk About That goes deeper.

Because the conversations we avoid are often the ones we need most.

title: Courageously Caitlin
author: Caitlin Sheets
description: Courageously Caitlin is a podcast where faith meets real life. Join me as we chat about Jesus, the hilltops and valleys, finding hope and cultivating joy in the midst of our everyday! Whether you are new to your faith, navigating uncertainty, or needing encouragement, this podcast is here to remind you that you aren’t alone & that God is for you! Together, we will dive into the deep sharing scripture, testimonies and explore what it means to live courageously with Jesus at the center. Let’s pursue the life God has called us to live - one conversation at a time. Welcome my beautiful friend! 🩷

title: Insurance Traps & Pitfalls
author: David Scheidemantle
description: Insurance Traps & Pitfalls makes smart policyholders smarter. Host David Scheidemantle of Scheidemantle Law Group draws on years of experience in the coverage trenches to deliver engaging discussions on what insurance companies are up to and how policyholders & businesses can protect themselves, while decoding insurance jargon when insurers deny.

title: Pressure
author: Gregory van der Wiel
description: Behind every great career is a person you’ve never truly met. On Pressure, Gregory van der Wiel sits down with people who reached the top of their field to talk about what success really costs: the pressure, fear, sacrifice, setbacks and identity behind the performance. These are not traditional interviews. They are honest conversations shaped by someone who lived it himself, from Ajax and PSG to the 2010 World Cup Final, and the difficult years that followed. This is the side of success that never makes the broadcast.

title: Breaking the Mould
author: katherinenowill
description:
Breaking the Mould is the podcast exploring the future of the plastics and manufacturing industries through the people driving change.

Each episode features conversations with industry leaders, manufacturers, educators, policymakers, training providers, innovators and emerging talent, discussing the issues shaping modern manufacturing - from injection moulding, automation and sustainability to skills, apprenticeships, leadership, education and workforce development.

Whether you're a manufacturer, engineer, recruiter, educator, student or simply interested in how British industry is evolving, Breaking the Mould offers practical insights, fresh perspectives and inspiring stories from across the sector.

Discover how innovation, collaboration and investment in people are helping to build a stronger, more sustainable and more skilled manufacturing future.

title: The Turquoise Witness
author: Catherine
description:
We are clear about the need for racial healing which will continue to be a part of
our conversations, but we clearly see the necessity for enlarging that conversation
to explore planetary healing which includes race, but many other areas as well. We cannot afford to ignore environmental issues and challenges such as climate change, food deserts, homelessness, and loneliness, which the Surgeon General has declared to be at a pandemic level. We will ensure that all of our efforts are inclusive of the race, gender, class, age, and physical ability narratives that need to be seriously interrogated in our culture. 
Our selected guests will represent a very diverse demographic in terms of race, age, and stage of life. We know that the more we engage across as many barriers as possible, the more opportunities are created for true sustainable healing to occur.

title: Welcome to the Horror Show
author: LifeFellowshipFM
description:
Welcome to the Horror Show is a series about facing the fears we usually hide from: rejection, failure, intimacy, and losing control. Each message explores how fear can keep us from honesty, healing, deep relationships, and the life God is calling us into. But this series is not about fear winning. It is about learning to bring those fears into the light, trust the perfect love of Jesus, and take the next brave step toward freedom.
This series contains occasional minor audio glitches from a hardware issue we later discovered. The message remains understandable, so we’re making it available.

title: Welcome to We Don't Share Blankets
author: Kristina and Gary
description:
We’re Kristina and Gary—married for more than 23 years and living a life that definitely didn’t follow the plan.
This is a podcast about marriage, family, caregiving, memoirs, mishaps, ridiculous stories, hard seasons, lots of laughter, and finding the good stuff somewhere in the middle of all of it.
In this short pilot episode, we’re introducing ourselves, sharing why we decided to start a podcast, and giving you a little taste of what’s ahead.
Marriage. Memoirs. Mishaps. And everything in between.

title: Big Hair Walking
author: Stefanie Cabaniss
description:
The Big Hair Walking: Christian Health Podcast for Women Over 40 | Midlife Strength, Faith & Healthy Aging
For every Christian woman over 40 who’s ever thought...
”I didn’t know it would be like this.”
Life has a way of asking more of us than we expected.
And we have a way of carrying more than we’ve been asked.
If you remember big hair, Walkmans, and walking just because it felt good, you’re in the right place.
The Big Hair Walking Podcast is a Christian podcast for women navigating midlife, menopause, healthy aging, grief, caregiving, changing health, and the everyday challenges of the second half of life.
Hosted by Stef Cabaniss, MA, MPH—health coach, public health professional, and fellow traveler—each episode explores practical ways to build strength, health, and hope through walking, strength training, healthy habits, faith, and evidence-based health coaching.
Whether you’re looking for encouragement, healthier habits, more energy, greater resilience, or a deeper faith, you’ll find honest conversations that help you keep walking through whatever life brings.
This podcast is for Christian women, women over 40, and any woman who’s lived enough life to know it rarely goes according to our plans—but still believes there’s more life ahead.
No pressure.
No striving.
No pretending.
Just one small step at a time—because the smallest steps often result in the biggest changes.
If you’re ready to live stronger in the second half, welcome.
You’re not done.
Not yet.

title: What's Your Passion?
author: Caleb Ervin
description: Welcome to What's Your Passion? Podcast. When I started this show I was 25 years old still struggling to understand my purpose here on earth. You go to work, you come home to eat, you go to bed, and repeat. This show was the forethought to get ahead of that and begin to explore with numerous guests about what their passion is, in a world where everyone is driven by passion or they have no drive at all. This is to explore the deeper critical theory about life in general. We welcome all in this safe space to think how you think, and believe how you believe.

title: People Don’t with Rivkie Kahn
author: Rivkie Kahn
description: People Don’t with Rivkie Kahn explores the gap between what people know, want, and actually do. Through psychology, human behavior, Jewish thought, relationships, leadership, and personal growth, Rivkie asks why people resist change and repeat familiar patterns. With warmth and curiosity, this podcast looks beneath the surface at identity, belonging, fear, and hope. For educators, leaders, parents, and anyone trying to understand people more deeply, People Don’t offers a way to make sense of behavior and meaningful change. People don’t need to be simplified. They need to be understood.

title: Homeland Journey
author: Stewart Muir
description:
Homeland Journey is a documentary interview series from Resource Works that travels into the territories of Indigenous nations across western Canada to let their own leaders tell their own stories.

Each episode is a sit-down conversation, filmed on the land it's about, with hereditary chiefs, elected leaders, and community members who are working to revive their languages and cultures while building real economic self-determination for their people — through forestry, energy, mining, and other resource partnerships that are made on their own terms.

Homeland Journey doesn't come at these conversations as outsiders explaining a community from a distance. It sits down, listens, and lets the people who carry the names, the laws, and the responsibility for their territories speak for themselves — about governance and hereditary law, about the land and what it means to them, about the hard history that got their nations here, and about what self-determination looks like when it's built by the community itself rather than handed to it.

Since launching in 2019, Homeland Journey has featured leaders from nations across British Columbia, and the series continues to expand its reach into new communities across western Canada, one conversation at a time.

New episodes and the full archive are available at resourceworks.com/homelandjourney and on the Homeland Journey YouTube channel.

Homeland Journey is produced by Resource Works.

author: Alison Carter
description: This Ancient Life tells stories about archaeology for non-archaeologists. We reveal the backstory behind exciting archaeological research and highlight the connections between past and present.

title: Forward To Joy
author: Alexandra Wyman
description: Alexandra Wyman was faced with immense grief when her husband died by suicide in 2020, instantly leaving her a widow and single mom. Since then, she has been finding ways to work through her grief, navigate parenthood and take steps to finding joy again. Join Alexandra on her continued grief journey, find some tips and tricks, hear from others about their grief journey and know you are not alone. Alexandra is an advocate and public speaker for resources in the aftermath of suicide.

description: Welcome to Chat with Dr. Hairston, where we’re Making Health Make Sense™ One Conversation at a Time. Hosted by Dr. Shan’Tyia Hairston, this podcast simplifies healthcare, mental health, insurance, leadership, and wellness into practical, easy-to-understand conversations. Whether you’re a patient, caregiver, healthcare professional, or simply curious, you’ll gain knowledge, confidence, and real-life tools to make informed decisions. Join us as we learn, grow, and navigate healthcare together, one conversation at a time.

title: Tiki Tapas - Spanish Futbol Beyond Big Two
author: The Tiki Tapas Podcast
description:
Tiki Tapas brings you closer to Spanish football than ever before. Hosted by Spanish football journalists Vic (ig: laligavic) and Rahul (ig: laligalondon), the show dives deep into La Liga and the wider Spanish game in English. 
New episodes drop every Monday, focusing beyond the big two to spotlight the clubs, players, and stories often overlooked in Spanish football. 
From tactical analysis and rising teams to transfer talk and fan culture, each episode also features special segments highlighting the games and moments of the week, giving fans a fresh and entertaining take on Spanish Futbol.

description:
This show’s dedicated to the builders. The restless ones. The ones who see what isn't there yet. The ones shaping our future across Fintech, AI, Climate, Mobility, Healthtech, and Defense. The ones you've never heard of, and the ones you have. 
They're building the future right now, Chasing Impact.
